decisive_spans.text: nausea, vomiting, and right lower-quadrant abdominal pain
on incision of the cyst wall purulent fluid was noted

response.rationale: The patient presents with classic symptoms of PID (lower abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting) along with laboratory evidence of infection (elevated WBC and CRP) and purulent fluid found during surgery. While ovarian torsion is considered due to the tender right lower quadrant and cystic mass, the presence of purulent fluid and inflammatory markers strongly points towards an infectious process like PID. Appendicitis is contradicted by the clinically normal appendix and the presence of a large cystic mass.
